listed_quote.quote: FS Investment Corporation (NYSE: FSIC) and Corporate Capital Trust, Inc. (NYSE: CCT) have entered into a definitive agreement under which FSIC and CCT will be merged.

announcement.quote: FS/KKR Announces Agreement to Merge FS Investment Corporation and Corporate Capital Trust

outcome_evidence.quote: today announced that the merger of FS Investment Corporation (NYSE: FSIC) and Corporate Capital Trust, Inc. (NYSE: CCT) has closed, creating the second-largest publicly traded business development company.

deals.notes: Shareholders of both funds approved on 2018-12-03 (8-K 0001193125-18-341163); merger closed 2018-12-19 and FSIC was renamed FS KKR Capital Corp. (NYSE: FSK). Episode fund is the surviving acquirer.
